original: 今回の仕事では、コンフェイト大森林に\n行ってもらうね
traducao: For this job, I need you to head to\nthe Confeito Great Forest.

original: あそこにいるケイブレックスという魔物が\nウズマキフスベを食べていたって\n記録があったらしいの
traducao: Apparently, records show that a monster\ncalled Cavelex in that forest\nfed upon the Whirl Puffball.

original: それで、ケイブレックスに\nウズマキフスベのドクメントがあるかも\nしれないって事で、今回行ってもらうわけ
traducao: So, because the Cavelex might retain\nthe Document of the Whirl Puffball,\nwe are asking you to go investigate.

original: 同行者は、セネル君とティア
traducao: Your companions will be Senel and Tear.

original: ゴツーイ魔物を相手にしなきゃいけないから\n大変だろうけど、お願いね
traducao: Facing such a huge monster will be tough,\nbut we're counting on you!

original: ケイブレックスか。\nまずはそいつを探し出さないとな
traducao: A Cavelex, huh?\nFirst, we've got to track it down.

original: リタから、ウズマキフスベの\nドクメントピースが入っている\nギベオンチップを借りて来たわ
traducao: I borrowed a Gibeon chip from Rita\ncontaining a Document piece of the\nWhirl Puffball.

original: これをケイブレックスに当てれば、\nドクメントを採取出来るらしいの
traducao: If we apply this to the Cavelex,\nwe can reportedly extract the Document.

original: そう、簡単に採取出来るとは\n思えないけどな
traducao: I doubt it'll be that easy\nto extract, though.

original: そうね。\n戦闘になる事も考えられるわ
traducao: Indeed.\nWe must be prepared for a fight as well.

original: いたわ。\nケイブレックスよ
traducao: There it is.\nIt's a Cavelex.

original: よし、安全にドクメントを\n採取する為にも\nまずは動きを封じるぞ！
traducao: All right, to safely extract\nthe Document, we'll pin it down\nand stop its movements first!

original: どうやら\nまだここに居てくれた様ね
traducao: It seems\nit's still lingering here.

original: ああ、逃げられてしまう前に\n片付けるぞ！
traducao: Yeah, let's take care of it\nbefore it gets away!

original: ギベオンチップに、ドクメントが入ったわ
traducao: The Document entered the Gibeon chip.

original: そうか。\nじゃあ、これで仕事は終わりだな
traducao: I see.\nThen that wraps up the job, right?

original: いえ、今のはあくまで\nウズマキフスベのドクメントの一部が\n手に入っただけ
traducao: No, what we obtained just now\nwas merely a part of the\nWhirl Puffball's Document.

original: まだ、集める必要があるわ
traducao: We still need to collect more.

original: じゃあ、まだケイブレックスを\n探す必要があるんだな
traducao: So we've still got to track down\nmore Cavelexes, then.

original: ええ、もっと奥へ行ってみましょう
traducao: Yes, let's head further inside.

original: いたぞ！\nケイブレックスだ
traducao: Found one!\nIt's a Cavelex!

original: 気が立っているわ。\n戦うしか無さそうね
traducao: It's on high alert.\nIt looks like we have to fight.

original: 一気に畳み込む。\n行くぞ！
traducao: We'll finish this in one go.\nLet's move!

original: 次は気を付けろ。\n潰されない様にな！
traducao: Be careful on the next one.\nDon't get crushed!

original: どうだ。\nウズマキフスベのドクメントは\nあったか
traducao: How'd it go?\nDid it have the Whirl Puffball's\nDocument?

original: ええ
traducao: Indeed.

original: でも、あと少し足りないみたい
traducao: However, it still seems slightly short.

original: まだ、採取する必要があるわ
traducao: We still need to extract more.

original: まだ、あんなのを相手にしないと\nいけないのか…
traducao: We've still got to take on\nmore of those things...?

original: ここら辺りがケイブレックスの棲家だと\n聞いたんだが…
traducao: I heard around here was the habitat\nof the Cavelex, but...

original: しょうがない、他の場所を探して\nまた後で来ようぜ
traducao: No helping it. Let's check other spots\nand come back here later.

original: ここにもいたか
traducao: There's one here too, huh.

original: 向こうもこっちに気付いてる。\n来るわよ！
traducao: It noticed us too.\nHere it comes!

original: いたわ。\nみんな構えて！
traducao: There it is.\nEveryone, battle positions!

original: ああ、わかってる！
traducao: Yeah, on it!

original: ウズマキフスベのドクメントが\n全て埋まったわ
traducao: The Whirl Puffball's Document\nhas been completely filled.

original: 任務完了か。\nそれじゃ、船に戻ろう
traducao: Mission complete, then.\nLet's head back to the ship.

original: ええ
traducao: Indeed.

original: ここは、ケイブレックスの目撃が\n多い場所らしいけれど。\n…いないわね
traducao: This is reportedly a spot where many\nCavelexes are sighted, but...\n...None here, it seems.

original: それじゃあ、\n今は他の場所を当たって、\nまた後に来ましょう
traducao: In that case,\nlet's try other areas for now\nand return here later.

original: お疲れ様
traducao: Welcome back.

original: これで、ウズマキフスベの\n完全なドクメントが\n手に入れられたんだね
traducao: So with this, we've obtained\na complete Document for the\nWhirl Puffball, then.

original: これで、塩水晶、ツリガネトンボ草、\nウズマキフスベのドクメントを組み合わせて、\n封印次元を作る事が出来るわ
traducao: Now, combining Documents of Salt Crystal,\nBell Dragonfly Herb, and Whirl Puffball,\nwe can forge the Sealing Dimension.

original: 長い道のりだったね…
traducao: It has been such a long journey...

original: あの暁の従者の二人の働きで、\n侵食浄化はもとより、また世界中の人々が\n手を繋ぎ始めたそうよ
traducao: Thanks to the two Dawn Cultists, not only\nis erosion cleansed, but people across\nthe world are joining hands again.

original: 握手で○○の能力と、\n助け合う為の繋がりが作られているの
traducao: Through handshakes, ○○'s ability and\nbonds of mutual aid are being formed.

original: 一人のディセンダーから、\n希望の光は世界中に灯っていく
traducao: From a single Descender,\nthe light of hope spreads to the world.

original: わたし達はその神話を、\n今まさに目にしてるのね…
traducao: We are bearing witness to that myth\nwith our very own eyes right now...

original: 組み上げたドクメントは、\nマナの流れに乗せて、\n世界樹へ送り込めばいいの
traducao: We just place the assembled Document\nupon the mana currents and channel it\nstraight into the World Tree.

original: それで、封印次元を形成出来るわ
traducao: Then we can form the Sealing Dimension.

original: 封印次元を作ったあとは、世界樹を媒体に\nラザリスの情報を送信させればいいの
traducao: Once it's formed, we send Lazaris's info\nusing the World Tree as a medium.

original: となると、この計画は\n聖地ラングリースで行うのが良さそうね
traducao: In that case, conducting this plan in the\nHoly Land of Langriths would be best.

original: よし、急いで準備を始めましょう。\nそれまで待ってなさい
traducao: All right, let us prepare in haste.\nWait until then!

original: ○○、\nちょっと話があんの
traducao: ○○,\nI need to talk to you for a second.

original: あたし、あんたがディセンダーってわかって\nすぐに、あんまり当てにしない方が良さそう\n…って言ったけど
traducao: When I first learned you were a Descender,\nI said we shouldn't rely on you too much\n...remember?

original: あれ、謝るわ。\nゴメン
traducao: I want to apologize for that.\nI'm sorry.

original: いや、うーん。\nあんたが良くても、\nあたしはスジ通しときたいんだもん
traducao: Well, look.\nEven if you don't mind, I want to\nsettle things properly between us.

original: 気にしてないって？
traducao: You say you don't mind?

original: はぁ、まーあんたらしいけどさー…
traducao: Sigh, well that's just like you, but...

original: これは、あたし自身のケジメでも\nあるんだから
traducao: This is also a matter of settling things\nwith myself, you know.

original: つか、ディセンダーがどうとかじゃなくて、\nあたしもやれる事をあんたみたいに\nやれば良かったなって
traducao: I mean, setting aside being a Descender,\nI wish I had just done what I could,\njust like you did.

original: あの時は、甘ったれてたわねーって\n思うわ
traducao: Looking back, I realize\nI was just being spoiled and childish.

original: そんだけよ
traducao: That's all.

original: ただ、あんたって…。\n予言で伝えられている通り\n世界を救ったら、世界樹へ帰っちゃうワケ？
traducao: It's just, you...\nOnce you save the world as prophesied,\nwill you return to the World Tree?

original: あ〜…、聞いて欲しくなかった？
traducao: Ah... You didn't want me to ask that?

original: そこは触れないでくれって事？
traducao: Meaning I shouldn't touch that subject?

original: とにかくさ、あんたがいなくなったら\nここのみんなが悲しむじゃん
traducao: Anyway, if you were to disappear,\neveryone here would be devastated.

original: そうは言っても、\nあたし達はあんたの決める事を\n止められないけど
traducao: Even so,\nwe can't stop you from doing\nwhatever you decide, though.

original: だって、あんたは誰にも、何にも縛られない\n自由なディセンダーだからさ
traducao: Because you're a free Descender, bound\nby no one and nothing, after all.

original: ま、そーいうわけで、前の言葉、取り消すわ。\nホントにゴメン
traducao: Well, so I take back what I said before.\nI'm really sorry.

original: 気にしていない、と言う
traducao: Say you don't mind

original: 笑って返す
traducao: Laugh in response

original: 黙る
traducao: Remain silent

original: 苦笑する
traducao: Smile wryly

original: アンジュ。\n準備が整ったわ
traducao: Ange.\nPreparations are complete.

original: ええ。\nそれじゃあ、依頼として登録するね
traducao: Yes.\nThen I'll register it as a quest.

original: 私も行っていい？
traducao: Can I come too?

original: いいわよ。\nでも、念の為にもう一人、\n募集した方がいいかな
traducao: Sure.\nJust to be safe, though, we had better\nrecruit one more person.

original: そうね。\n腕に自信のありそうな奴\n募集しといて
traducao: Good idea.\nGo recruit someone who looks\nconfident in their fighting skills.
